reapack.name: juno_ExtendNotes.lua
reapack.desc: juno: Extend notes or items to the next one

version.author: juno
version.changelog: - Works on audio/video items too: run it with items selected in the arrange view to extend each item to the next item on its track. MIDI items always have their notes extended, never the items.

reapack.name: juno_FixOverlaps.lua
reapack.desc: juno: Fix overlapping, duplicate and short notes or items

version.author: juno
version.changelog: - Works on audio/video items too: run it with items selected in the arrange view to remove duplicate and short items and trim overlapping ones, with an optional crossfade. MIDI items always have their notes fixed, never the items. - Option to keep or remove the existing fades of overlapping items when trimming them - Option to cut overlapping items at the start, middle or end of their overlap

reapack.name: juno_MIDIExportHelper.lua
reapack.desc: juno: MIDI export helper (MIDI and pitched samples to MIDI tracks)

version.author: juno
version.changelog: - Select tracks like files (click, Ctrl/Cmd+click, Shift+click), in sync with REAPER's track selection; ticking, split modes and voice settings apply to every selected track - Clearer selection highlight - Warnings column: muted items, notes cut at the export range, rounded or clamped pitches, clashing slides - "Remove all exports" button (with confirmation) - Tick buttons for all / none / MIDI tracks / sample tracks, and a filter box - Each created track starts with a text event naming its instrument plugin or source file(s) - Better drum detection: drum words in the track name, its folders or its instrument plugin - Fixed: previews drawn over other parts of the window; crash with folder rows

reapack.desc: juno: Bake volume (move track fader volume into an FX, with revert)
